cuisine.name: Chicken Grill
cuisine.description: Savor the juicy grilled chicken that has been skillfully seasoned with herbs and spices that are reflective of the island, showcasing the variety of food traditions in the area.

cuisine.name: Mauritian Biryani
cuisine.description: A unique blend of Indian and Mauritian flavors, this biryani is cooked with marinated meat and fragrant spices.

cuisine.name: Grilled Lobster
cuisine.description: Enjoy the delicious taste of perfectly seasoned and roasted grilled lobster, which showcases the unique features of the island's coast.

cuisine.name: Thai Chicken Curry
cuisine.description: Savor the bold flavors of Thai Chicken Curry, which consists of soft chicken simmered in a creamy coconut milk sauce that is flavored with fragrant herbs and spices.

cuisine.name: Mine Bouille
cuisine.description: A delicious noodle soup served with vegetables, seafood, or meat, perfect for a light meal.

cuisine.name: Paneer Tikka
cuisine.description: Paneer Tikka is a popular Indian appetizer made of marinated cubes of paneer (Indian cottage cheese) grilled or roasted, often served with mint chutney and garnished with onions and peppers.

cuisine.name: Safran grilled prawns
cuisine.description: Experience the exquisite flavors of safran grilled prawns, marinated in aromatic spices and grilled to perfection for a delightful seafood treat.

cuisine.name: Chicken Burger
cuisine.description: A delicious double chicken burger featuring two crispy, lightly fried chicken fillets, served with fresh toppings and a burst of flavor in every bite.

cuisine.name: Mauritian 7 curry
cuisine.description: The most common vegetables used in Mauritian cuisine are tomatoes, onions, lalo (okra), brinzel (eggplants), chou chou (chayote), lay (garlic) and pima (chillies).
